# Resource: tfe_gcp_oidc_configuration

Manages a GCP OIDC configuration.

~> **Note:** This resource requires using the provider with HCP Terraform on the HCP Terraform Premium edition. Refer to [HCP Terraform pricing](https://www.hashicorp.com/en/pricing?product_intent=terraform&tab=terraform) for details.

## Example Usage

```typescript
import * as constructs from "constructs";
import * as cdktf from "cdktf";
/*Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.*/
import * as tfe from "./.gen/providers/tfe";
class MyConvertedCode extends cdktf.TerraformStack {
  constructor(scope: constructs.Construct, name: string) {
    super(scope, name);
    new tfe.gcpOidcConfiguration.GcpOidcConfiguration(this, "example", {
      organization: "my-org-name",
      projectNumber: "11111111",
      serviceAccountEmail: "myemail@gmail.com",
      workloadProviderName:
        "projects/1/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/1/providers/1",
    });
  }
}

```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `projectNumber` (String) The GCP Project containing the workload provider and service account.
- `serviceAccountEmail` (String) The email of your GCP service account, with permissions to encrypt and decrypt using a Cloud KMS key.
- `workloadProviderName` (String) The fully qualified workload provider path. This should be in the format `projects/{projectNumber}/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/{workloadIdentityPoolId}/providers/{workloadIdentityPoolProviderId}`.

### Optional

- `organization` (String) Name of the organization. If omitted, organization must be defined in the provider config.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the GCP OIDC configuration.



## Import

Resource tfe_gcp_oidc_configuration can be imported in the following format: 

```shell
# via <GCP OIDC ID>
terraform import tfe_gcp_oidc_configuration.example gcpoidc-PuXEeRoSaK3ENGj9
```
